basis: Parasitic infection; intestinal and urinary injury varies by species and stage, with no established >=30% damaging organ manifestation across the umbrella.

decisions.renal: none: urinary inflammation and scarring characterize particular species/forms; damaging urinary disease in >=30% across this umbrella is not established.
decisions.gastrointestinal: none: intestinal injury is species-dependent; damage in >=30% across all schistosomiasis, including asymptomatic infections, is not established.

basis: Combined immunodeficiency, pancytopenia and microcephaly/developmental impairment define LIG4 syndrome; hypothyroidism is a separately diagnosed associated disease.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: hypothyroidism in 2/4 meets the numerical threshold but is a separately diagnosed associated disorder, without evidence of direct thyroid injury by LIG4 deficiency.

basis: Major forms involve testicular endocrine differentiation, androgen synthesis or androgen action; additional organ damage is subtype-specific.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: this umbrella principally comprises gonadal endocrine development and androgen synthesis/action disorders, supporting the endocrine axis.

basis: Skeletal overgrowth and macroglossia define it; developmental impairment ~60% and renal malformations ~50-60%. Cardiac defects (~30-45%) omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: congenital cardiac defects affect roughly 30-45% and qualify, but are omitted at the cap in favor of more frequent renal and neurologic damage.
decisions.renal: involved: structural renal malformations affect approximately 50-60%, including dysplasia and collecting-system abnormalities.
decisions.neurologic: involved: developmental impairment is common; supplied motor delay is 8/13 and speech/language delay 5/7, supporting roughly 60% or more.

basis: GM-CSF receptor deficiency causes intrinsic alveolar macrophage dysfunction and impaired surfactant clearance, producing pulmonary alveolar proteinosis.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: localized surfactant accumulation results from defective macrophage clearance; the condition is an immune receptor defect rather than a primary metabolic disorder.
decisions.infectious_immune: primary: CSF2RB deficiency impairs GM-CSF signaling and alveolar macrophage function, constituting an inherited immune defect.

basis: Thoracic skeletal dysplasia defines it; pulmonary hypoplasia with asphyxia is a major defining manifestation. Renal and hepatic injury frequencies are not established.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: pulmonary hypoplasia and respiratory failure are major manifestations of the asphyxiating thoracic dysplasia, qualifying without a numerical frequency.
decisions.renal: none: renal hypoplasia and cystic dysplasia are reported, but neither a >=30% frequency nor a defining renal criterion is established for this subtype.

basis: CNS germ-cell malignancy explicitly involving the pineal body, an endocrine gland; the anatomical endocrine label does not require hormone dysfunction.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: the definition specifies tumour involvement of the pineal body, an endocrine gland; gland involvement qualifies without demonstrated hormone dysfunction.

basis: SCID with defining skeletal dysplasia and profound T/B lymphocyte depletion (80-99%); recurrent infections are separate diseases and anemia is occasional.

decisions.haematologic: primary: absence of T and B lymphocytes is explicitly defining, with decreased lymphocyte counts in 80-99%; this is a direct blood-cell defect, independent of occasional anemia.

basis: Definition emphasizes intellectual disability, cardiac and urinary malformations; anophthalmia occurs in 30-79%. Skeletal abnormalities (30-79%) omitted at the four-axis cap.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: cardiac defects are explicitly a principal defining feature; individual VSD/PDA frequencies of 5-29% do not establish the aggregate cardiac frequency.
decisions.renal: primary: urogenital malformations are a principal defining feature, with multicystic kidney dysplasia specifically annotated at 30-79%.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: camptodactyly and other skeletal abnormalities occur in 30-79% and qualify, but are omitted at the cap in favor of the defining organs and severe ocular defects.

basis: Cutaneous melanocytic nevus with immune-mediated melanocyte destruction producing the characteristic depigmented halo.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: immune-mediated destruction of nevus and surrounding melanocytes produces the defining halo; this is intrinsic to the lesion.
